newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index climbs again in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index climbs again in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 101.5 points or 2.93 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries index eased 0.51 percent. Changes, in percent:
Jan 24 Jan 17 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said situation stocks created frenzied activity in the juniors - "like spot fires blazing out of control across the speculative sector."
Gains outnumbered falls by a ratio of four to three.

The big winner was Desertstone NL, which jumped 36 cents to 63 cents on a hint of a gold intersection at its Lake Torrens prospect in the Gawler Craton area of South Australia, although no formal assay results were available.
Among tenement neighbours, Stuart Metals NL rose 8.5 cents to 32 cents and General Gold Resourses NL was up two cents at 40 cents.
Uranium explorer Noble Resources NL continued its strong move, rising nine cents to 33 cents.

Other upward movers included Capricorn Resources Australia NL, up four cents to 16 cents, and Strategic Minerals Corp, up 4.6 cents to 14 cents - both improving on interest in South Australian exploration acreage.
